tagline: Fuji数码单反相机，1980 年发布
description: Fuji于1980年推出的数码单反相机。快门速度electronic cloth focal plane, from 1/2 to 1/1000 sec in 1/4 steps。使用Single-stroke。感光度ISO/ASA 12 - 3200, in 1/3 step。

specs.取景器: LED shutter speed indication, over and underexposure warning, battery check.
specs.快门: electronic cloth focal plane, from 1/2 to 1/1000 sec in 1/4 steps
specs.自拍: Electronically controlled; with 12 sec delay and audible chime.
specs.英文简介: The AX-1 is a 35mm SLR camera manufactured by Fuji in 1980.
